primary_sources.title: Announcing the ARC White-Box Estimation Challenge
Estimating the expected output of wide random MLPs more efficiently than sampling

exact_identity.consequence: The omitted residual magnitude is exactly observable at the projection point.

impossibility_lemma.statement: If the certificate retains only residual norm rho in an omitted subspace, then for downstream linear sensitivity a the sharp deterministic bound is |a^T r| <= rho ||P_perp a||_2, and equality is attainable by alignment. Thus norm-only state cannot distinguish zero-impact residual orientation from worst-impact orientation for arbitrary dense weights.

nonlinear_extension.k3_d21_structure: Hadamard/bilinear contractions of transported source legs
nonlinear_extension.effect: Retained-plus-residual expansion creates orientation-sensitive first-order and bilinear residual terms. Scalar/block residual energy is not closed under these contractions.
nonlinear_extension.public_measurement_alignment: 504aldo F65/F66/F72/F73 report high-rank accuracy-relevant residuals, energy-metric failure, and sharp rank cliffs.

cost_blocker.note: This production-cost blocker applies specifically to layering the requested certificate onto the published 504aldo V29 source machinery.

internal_context.e132_certificate_failure: Global Gaussian-Poincare/Minkowski certificate exceeded target by >1e13x on frozen small corpus.

decision.scope: Only the requested norm-only Parseval/transport-residual deterministic certificate family is closed.
reason: Parseval certifies residual magnitude but discards downstream-relevant orientation.
For arbitrary dense weights the sharp deterministic norm-only bound is the worst-alignment operator bound.
D21 source contractions are Hadamard/bilinear and require directional cross-state for tight bounds.
Primary-source measurements show energy concentration is not a reliable accuracy certificate and expose sharp rank cliffs.
Orientation-aware exact residual tracking reconstructs omitted source state/cross-state rather than remaining a cheap certificate.
On published V29, even deleting the entire old tier leaves 0.150xB, already above the 0.135 project cap.
decision.successor_constraint: Any successor must provide a new exact orientation-aware sufficient statistic closed under D21/Hadamard transport at materially lower cost. It is not an E135 rescue and needs a new experiment ID.

receipt_policy: immutable theory receipt; no production run authorized under E135
